stimulus.source_note: Theodor de Bry, engraving published 1591 after drawings by Jacques Le Moyne de Morgues; public domain, Library of Congress.
stimulus.text: This engraving by Theodor de Bry, published in 1591 after drawings by the French artist Jacques Le Moyne de Morgues, shows Florida Indians planting seeds of beans and maize. Women carry baskets of seed while men dig the soil with hoes, working in rows across a cleared field. De Bry never visited Florida; he worked from Le Moyne's drawings and gave the figures European features.

parts.prompt: Identify the activity shown in the image.
Explain what the image shows about Native agriculture at the time of contact.
Explain one limitation of the image as evidence about Native life.

instruction: Answer each part in your own words from the stimulus only. Do not open the question file.
